C1_V6_Q_TRANSFER.interpretation: Exact symmetric extension of the frozen V6 C2 package score to both multi-asset sides. This does not assume it will transfer successfully.
C1_V6_Q_TRANSFER.role: zero-new-score-parameter transfer of validated V6 concentration geometry

C3_APEX_REMAINDER.interpretation: Separates apex value from remainder value without assuming a power norm.

player_selection.source: frozen LOG player FV snapshot generated after this preregistration

raw_sum_ratio_design.purpose: Keep choices near enough to parity to reveal concentration preference without constructing challenges from candidate predictions.

tiny_piece_primary_design.reason: Avoid confounding the primary topology study with an arbitrary symmetric tiny-piece threshold before multi-v-multi evidence exists.

development_catalog_preregistration.vote_prompt: Which side would you rather have in this dynasty league?

eligibility_gates: combined CV equal-topology macro log-loss improvement vs C0 >= 0.005
candidate improves vs C0 in at least 4 of 5 challenge-grouped folds
candidate improves or is within 0.002 log loss of C0 in at least 5 of 6 topologies
worst topology log-loss regression vs C0 <= 0.010
all mathematical invariants pass exactly/tolerance as applicable
no score parameter at a hard bound within 1e-6 relative
left-side nuisance bias does not change candidate ranking under delta_left=0 sensitivity
leave-one-player-out influence diagnostic shows no named-player dependence
mixed-asset motivating fixture was never used as a fit/selection outcome label
development_evaluation.primary_metric: equal-topology macro mean weighted negative log likelihood/log loss
development_evaluation.selection_rule: Among eligible C1/C2/C3 candidates choose lowest primary CV log loss. If candidates are within 0.001 absolute log loss, choose fewer free score parameters; C1 is therefore preferred to an effectively tied fitted model.
development_evaluation.weighting: equal weight to each of six topologies; within topology equal challenge weight; within challenge equal voter weight

forbidden: collecting V7 multi-v-multi votes before power checkpoint and catalog are frozen
using candidate predictions to choose development challenges
showing LOG FV or candidate scores to voters
using the motivating Sherwood trade as an answer label
tuning a candidate until the motivating trade changes verdict
using draft picks in the primary player-only development vote
using package votes to calibrate the pick/player bridge
changing existing V1.7 one-vs-package production behavior during Phase 1

required_before_pick_voting: freeze new Draft Pick FV calibration/bridge
define player-equivalent treatment for picks without using package votes
generate fresh mixed-asset catalog after those freezes

mock_vote_transport.next_stage_power_rule: Before activation, use only pre-existing V6 dependence/variance evidence plus the frozen 40-challenge geometry to select exactly one of 30/40/50 distinct-voter checkpoints. If none reaches the preregistered power target, stop/redesign rather than exceed 50 voters or use observed V7 votes.

motivation.current_live_gap: Production V1.7 fails closed on multi-v-multi trades and on any trade containing a draft pick, so supported verdict totals fall back to raw FV.

mixed_asset_real_trade_fixture.purpose: Expose the unsupported mixed-asset multi-v-multi topology. The study must not be tuned to force either side to win.
mixed_asset_real_trade_fixture.source: user-provided calculator screenshot; structural fixture only

required_robustness_tests: reverse every challenge side assignment and prove score ratio reciprocates
repeat every candidate with asset order permuted within each side
add a 1-point synthetic throw-in and prove bounded continuous score impact
scale every FV in a challenge by common positive constants and prove preference unchanged
verify same-size equal-total packages favor greater concentration only when the candidate mathematically implies it
verify legacy one-vs-two and one-vs-three production regression fixtures remain unchanged
verify any draft-pick-containing trade remains fail-closed in production during player-only development
research_question: For player-only trades where both sides contain multiple meaningful assets, does a symmetric concentration-aware side score predict human dynasty trade preference better than raw FV addition while preserving scale, side-swap symmetry, monotonicity, and the already-validated one-vs-package production path?

scope.why_picks_are_blocked: V7 Phase 0 found a material pick/player FV scale displacement. Mixed-asset package voting cannot be interpreted until an independent pick-to-player FV bridge is frozen.
